sentences.text: Radar transmits pulses of microwave energy and measures the time for echoes to return.
It measures range very accurately, and bearing somewhat less accurately, because the beam has width.
On the display, your boat is usually at the center, with a heading line pointing up and range rings to help judge distance.
The variable range marker, or V R M, measures range to a target, and the electronic bearing line, or E B L, measures its bearing.
If a target stays on your E B L while its range closes, its bearing is steady, and Rule seven says risk of collision exists.
